tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dge bsnyen rab byung dge tshul bsnyen rdzogs bcas bsgrub tshul 'khyer bde me tog phreng mdzes bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ dang por thugs bskyed bar du tshogs gnyis bsags/ /tha mar mngon sangs rgyas nas gdul bya la/ /'khor lo rnams gsum bskor nas don mdzad pa/ /zla med ston pa de la gus phyag 'tshal/ / mgon des gdul bya'i don du bslab gsum dang*/ /khyad par tshul khrims bslab pa mang gsungs las/ /rab byung bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa mchog /ji ltar len pa'i cho ga 'khyer bde brjod/ /༈ de yang rab byung nas bsnyen rdzogs par gyi sdom pa ji ltar len pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ni bu ston rin po che dang*/ rgyal dbang lnga ba'i las chog las 'byung ba ltar yin pas legs kyang*/ gzhan 'bog chog cung zad bsdus pa yang re gnyis snang ste de dag rnams su mkhan slob gnyis so sor byed pa dang*/ gcig gis kyang 'thus pa'i bshad pa gnyis ka 'byung ba'i dbang gis blo dman 'ga' zhig gis dbye ba legs por ma phyed pa'i phyag len 'khrul bcas byed par mthong ngo*/ /spyir 'phags yul na mkhan slob so sor mdzad pa'i srol dar yang*/ bod kyi phyogs 'dir sngon dus su so sor mdzad pa mang zhing da lta ni mkhan slob gnyis gcig gis go chod pa'i srol dar che'o/ /des na mkhan slob so sor byed na ni de la zhib cha mang ste 'dul ba'i gzhung che ba nas shes par bya la/ 'dir gzhan 'jug bde ba'i ched du mkhan slob gnyis gcig gis mdzad pa'i lugs tsam zhig gzhir bzhag nas 'chad cing*/ de'i tshe bshad pa rgyas bsdus ni skabs dang bstun no/ /de yang dge bsnyen/ rab byung*/ dge tshul/ bsnyen rdzogs rnams ji ltar bya ba'i tshul rim par brjod pa la/ gang du bya ba'i gnas khang byi dor byas la/ ston pa'i sku brnyan bzang po zhig bkram nas mdun du mchod pa bsham/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten gzhan yod na legs mod med kyang mi 'gal/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi yo byad dgos pa rnams sta gon bya zhing*/ dge bsnyen dang rab byung dge tshul gsum la las gral ba yod na legs kyang med na ni 'gal ba med la/

bsnyen rdzogs la ni las gral ba'i bsnyen rdzogs mang po yod na dang*/ gzhan drug gam lnga dang ma tha bzhi nges par dgos so/ /las gral pa rnams la me tog phul/ bsnyen rdzogs byed pa'i tshe ltung bshags dang ltung ba spyi bshags sngon du byas na 'jug pa bde/ de nas dge bsnyen gcig bu sgrub pa la bar chad 'dri me dgos shing*/ rab byung dang dkyus gcig la sgrub na ni bar chad 'dri dgos so/ /de yang thog mar 'dri srol yod pa ltar mdzad na/ 'o/ khyed cag rab tu 'byung ba la bar chad kyi chos dang mi ldan pa zhig dgos la/ bar chad can rab byung sogs byas na rgyud de la sdom pa mi skye ba'am/ skyes kyang yun du mi gnas pa sogs kyis rgyud la phan mi thogs shing*/ sgrub mkhan la yang nyes pa 'byung bas dri ba 'di rnams la sems ma g.yeng bar lan thob cig khyed mu stegs can ma yin nam/ des ma lags zhes lan 'debs shing*/ de bzhin du/ lo bcwo lnga ma lon pa ma yin nam/ lo bcwo lnga lon pa bya rog skrod mi nus pa ma yin nam/ bya rog skrod nus pa lo bdun ma lon pa ma=/ bran la sogs pa=/ bu lon chags pa=/ pha mas ma gnang ba ma yin nam/ pha mas ma gnang pa yul thag mi ring ba=/ nad pa=/ dge slong ma sun phyung ba=/ rku thabs su gnas pa=/ tha dad du gnas pa=/ gnas par mi bya ba=/ za ma=/ ma ning =/ sprul pa=/ dud 'gro=/ mu stegs can zhugs pa=/ ma bsad pa=/ pha bsad pa=/ dgra bcom pa bsad pa=/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa=/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung ba=/ pham par 'gyur ba'i ltung ba bzhi po dag las ltung ba gang yang rung ba byung ba=/ rgyu las bzlog pa'i chad pa khas mi len pas gnas nas phyung ba=/ lag rdum la sogs pa=/ skra ser la sogs pa=/ sor mo gcig pa la sogs pa=/ rgyal pos bkrabs pa la sogs pa=/ rgyal pos ma gnang ba=/ rgyal pos ma gnang ba yul thag mi ring ba=/ chom rkun par grags pa=/ phung khrol ba=/

lham mkhan=/ gdol pa=/ g.yung po=/ mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba po=/ byang gi sgra mi snyan pa=/ mtshan lan gsum du gyur pa=/ skyes pa 'dra ba'i bud med=/ sdig sdig lta bu'i mtshan nyid can=/ gling gzhan nas skyes pa tshul byad mi 'dra ba ma yin nam/ zhes dris pas/ ma yin lags zhes zer na/ 'o na/ kho bos khyod rab tu dbyung bar bya'o/ /zhes skabs dbye'o/ /de nas/ bstan pa rim gyis bslab pa'i phyir dge bsnyen du bsgrub pa la/ bsgrub bya de dang por ston pa la phyag gsum dang*/ de nas rang la yang phyag gsum byed du bcug ste mdun du tsog pur 'dug tu 'jug cing*/ thal mo snying khar sbyor du bcug la/ khyed rnams sam/ khyod dge bsnyen du sgrub pa la bsam pa 'di bzhin gyis/ lus rten 'di lta bu rnyed dka' zhing 'jig par sla ba dang*/ shi nas las kyi dbang gis gar skye rang dbang med cing*/ gal te ngan 'gror skyes na sdug bsngal chen po myong bar 'gyur bas de la skyob pa'i skyabs ni dkon mchog gsum yin pas/ de gsum la snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro dgos/ 'dir ngan song las thar 'dod yod pa tsam gyis mi chog gi 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du mthong nas 'khor ba spyi las thar 'dod bskyed dgos/ sdom pa skye ba'i gzhi ni skyabs 'gro rnam dag dang*/ 'khor ba las thar 'dod gnyis yin pas de gnyis rnam dag gam/ bcos ma tshun chad kyis bskyed dgos pa yin/ der ma zad/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyang dgos pas sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas bslab pa'i gzhi lnga 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs nas ma shi'i bar du legs par srung snyam pa'i bsam pa khyad par can dung ba zhig bskyed la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bar 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog

/sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dge bsnyen du btsun pas gzung du gsol/ 'di lan gsum brjod dgos pas gnyis pa'i rjes zlos gy-is/ gsum pa song ba'i rjes su/ 'di la skyabs brjod/ bdag brjod/ gzhan brjod gsum yod pa'i bdag brjod dge bsnyen du zhes pa'i tshig rdzogs pa dang mnyam du khyed kyi rgyud la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa skye zhing*/ nged khyed kyi slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas/ dge bsnyen du zhes pa'i skabs su ngas skad cung zad mtho bar byas te se gol gyi brda sprod pas/ de'i tshe bdag gi rgyud la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa skyes pa'i dus ni 'di yin snyam pa'i thob blo bskyed pa shin tu gal che zhing*/ sdom pa thob dus shes pa dang*/ slob dpon du gyur nas slob dpon gyis gzung du gsol zhes brjod dgos pas/ de yid la zhog la gsum pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gsum pa song ba dang slob dpon gyis/ thabs yin no/ /zhes dang*/ lan du legs so/ /zhes bya/ dge tshul du bsgrub na 'dir slob pa brjod mi dgos shing*/ dge bsnyen tsam mam rab byung man chad bsgrub na de brjod dgos pas/ bslab pa brjod pa ni/ des dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa thob pa yin/ thob kyang ma bsrungs na phan yon mi 'byung bar ma zad/ nyes dmigs 'byung bas bsrung lugs sngon gyi dgra bcom pa rnams kyis ji ltar bsrung ba bzhin bdag gis kyang bsrung snyam pa gyis la/ 'di'i lad mo gyis shig/༈ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o/

/yan lag dang po 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob po/ /rjes su bsgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /gzhan yang ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ma byin par len pa dang*/ 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang*/ brdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang dang*/ myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas spangs te/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang dang*/ myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas las slar ldog pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ma byin par len pa dang*/ 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang*/ brdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang dang*/ myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas spangs te/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang dang*/ myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas las slar ldog par bgyi'o/ /yan lag lnga pa 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo/ rjes su bsgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /lan gcig gis chog /thabs yin no dang*/ legs so zhes brjod/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs nas skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya bsgrub dgos shing*/ de la mang yang bsdu na/ 'jig rten pa'i lha la dad pas phyag mi 'tshal ba dang*/ sems can la gnod 'tshe spong ba dang*/ mu stegs can sogs dkon mchog la mi gus pa la snying grogs mi byed pa gsum dang*/ dkon mchog gsum mchod pa/ sems can la snying brtse ba/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa/ bslab pa srung ba sogs dang*/ mdor na mi dge bcu spong zhing dge bcu ci nus su bsgrub pa la 'bad par bya'o// //༈ de nas rab byung du sgrub pa la/ gding ba dang de'i steng du bla gos legs par bltab te 'jog pa dang*/ lhung bzed dang chu tshags sogs sta gon bya/ 'dir zhu yul dge slong bzhi sogs yod na zhu ba'i tshul bshad kyang de ni rgyas pa'i lugs yin pas grub na byas chog mod/

ma grub kyang mi 'gal bar nges pas bsdus pa'i skabs su bzhag ste/ bsgrub byas mkhan por 'os pa la phyag gsum byas nas mdun du tsog pur thal mo sbyor du bcug la/ khyed rnams sam/ khyed rab byung du sgrub pa la mkhan po zhig dgos shing*/ de yang gang rung rung gis mi chog pas bsnyen par rdzogs nas bar ma chad par lo bcu lon pa dang*/ 'dul ba shes pa'i brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis ldan zhig dgos shing*/ de lta bu kho bos 'grub rung du yod pas sngar gyi slob dpon la mkhan po zhu snyam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba slob dpon la mkhan por gsol gyis/ slob dpon bdag gi mkhan po mdzad du gsol/ slob dpon mkhan pos bdag rab tu dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gnyis brjod de/ gsum pa'i skabs su mkhan po mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i mjug tu nged khyed kyi mkhan por 'gyur ba yin pas/ de yid la zhog la gsum pa'i rjes zlos kyis/ gsum pa song ba'i mjug tu thabs legs bya'o/ /mkhan por gsol ba btab pa'i bslab byar mkhan po la ston pa'i 'du shes 'jog cing gus pa dang*/ bsnyen bkur dang*/ bka' bsgrub pa sogs bya dgos so/ /de nas gtsug phud 'bregs pa'i dge slong zhig la 'di'i gtsug phud 'bregs pa'i grogs ldan mdzod cig ces bsgo/ des chu bum dang skra gri bzung nas g.yas mchog sbyin byas pa de'i spyi bor gtugs te/ khyod gtsug phud 'bregs pa la spro'am zhes 'dri zhing*/ des kyang spro lags zhes byas nas bregs pa mkhan po la phul/ mkhan pos dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha rnams dgyes pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing rten phyogs su gtor/ de nas yan lag lnga chus bkru ba'am kha bshal/ de nas mkhan po'i mdun nas phyag gsum byas te tsog bur 'dug pa'i phrag g.yon la gding ba/ mthang gos/ bla gos gsum nang la brgyad bltab tu bkal nas/

chos gos kyi sne mo bsgrub bya'i lag pa g.yon pa'i khar bzhag /gnyis ka'i lag pa g.yas pas steng nas bkab ste/ 'di stod du rgyun tu gyon pa'i chos gos bla gos zhes bya ba khyim pa dang mu stegs can las rtags khyad par du 'gyur ba dge sbyong gi dran pa gso ba/ sbrang bu dang sha sprang dang rlung dang nyi ma la sogs pa'i tsha grang gi reg pa las skyob pa'i gos su ston pas gnang ba yin pas/ dus rgyun tu stod g.yogs 'di 'dra re 'chang snyam pa gyis/ zhes byas la phrag pa g.yas la bzhagamathang gos yang sngar bzhin bzung la/ 'di smad du gyon par byed pa'i mthang gos zhes bya ba smad gcer ba dang ngo tsha ba'i gnas las skyob/ sprang bu la sogs pa'i reg pa las srung*/ khyim pa dang mu stegs can las rtags khyad par du 'byung zhing*/ dge sbyong gi dran pa gso ba'i gos su ston pas gnang ba yin pas/ dus rgyun tu smad g.yogs 'di lta bu re 'chang snyam pa gyis/ ston pas kyang stod g.yogs smad g.yogs 'di lta bu bsnams nas 'di'i lam la bslab ste sangs rgyas nas/ rjes 'jug rnams la gos 'di lta bu gnang ba yin pas/ gos 'di lta bu gyon la sems dul ba dang zhi bar byed dgos pa yin zhes byas la g.yas su spo/ lhung bzed nang du 'bru blugs la gnyis ka'i lag pa g.yon 'og dang*/ g.yas steng nas bzung ste/ 'di lhung bzed ces bya ba khyim pa'i kha phor/ mu stegs kyi slong phor/ rab byung dman pa gzhan las snod spyad kyi rtags khyad par can du gyur pa yin/ 'di zas kyis 'gengs pa bzhin du rang gi shes rgyud yon tan gyis 'gengs/ 'di'i nang nas zas la longs spyod pa bzhin du chos la longs spyod/ mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i bsod snyoms spyod pa'i snod du ston pas gnang ba yin pas dus rgyun tu snod spyad 'di 'dra re 'chang snyam pa gyis/ de nas gding ba sngar bzhin byas la/ 'di gding ba bya ba khyim pa'i dkar po/

gang zag gi khra bo phal cher ma nyams pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi rtswa'i gdan ma gtogs gnas mal la longs spyod pa'i dus su 'dis bskyabs nas longs spyod dgos pa yin/ chu tshags gtad la/ 'di chu tshags bya ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni snying rjes rab tu phye ba yin zhing*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni gzhan gnod gzhi dang bcas pa las ldog pa yin pas/ sems can thams cad la gnod pa spang dgos/ khyad par du chu 'di 'brel che 'byung nye/ nang nub tu chu la longs spyod dgos pas chu tshags 'di 'dra re 'chang snyam pa dang*/ des mtshon nas yo byad gang la yang srog chags la mi gnod pa byed dgos so/ /zhes brjod de sbyin/ de nas mthang gos nyis bltab byas pa rgyab nas bskon/ de'i steng du bla gos brkyang ba bskon te/ g.yas g.yon gyi sne mo gnyis mdun du lhan cig tu byas nas thal mo sbyor du bcug ste/ mkhan po dge 'dun rnams kyis me tog gtor bzhin par/ thar ba'i rgyal mtshan brtan par gyur cig /tshangs par spyod pa tshe mthar phyin par gyur cig /tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du rab tu byung ba'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang ldan par gyur cig /ces smon lam gdab/ de nas bsgrub bya'i gding ba nyis bltab byas pa'i glegs bu phyed pa mdun phyogs su 'ong bar byas te bting*/ bsgrub byas de'i steng nas ston pa dang mkhan po la phyag gsum re byas te mdun du tsog bur 'dug ste thal mo snying khar sbyor du bcug la/ khyod rab byung du sgrub pa 'dod pa de legs/ legs pa'i rgyu mtshan mang yang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe khyim pa'i rten spangs te/ rab byung gi rten la 'tshang rgya ba yin gyi/ khyim pa'i rten la sangs rgyas pa med/ khyim pa'i rten la sbyin pa gtong ba dang*/ dge sbyor gzhan byas pa las rab byung gi rten la sbyin gtong dang*/

dge sbyor byas pa thams cad lhag par phan yon che/ khyim pa'i rten la chos bsgrub dka' zhing rab byung gi rten la sgrub sla ba sogs khyad chos du ma yod pas rab byung du sgrub pa don che/ 'di la brje ba rnam pa gsum dang ldan dgos shing*/ de yang rtags cha lugs brje ba/ bsam pa brje ba/ ming brje ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ rab byung gi cha lugs su bsgyur ba de yin/ bsam pa brje ba ni/ khyim gyi nyes dmigs rnams shes shing*/ rab tu byung ba'i phan yon rnams bsam pa dang*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pas yid skrag ste de las thar 'dod kyis khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched du dkon mchog la skyabs su song nas/ rab byung gi tshul khrims blangs te ma shi'i bar du bsrung snyam pa'i bsam pa shugs drag byed dgos pa yin/ ming brje ba ni/ khyod kyi ming la 'di bzhin gyis zhes byas la ming spo/ de yang dpal dang grags pa dang bzang po dang don yod dang 'od zer sogs dang*/ mkhan po'i ming gi mtha' can gang rung bya/ ming spos te/ da 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mkhan po dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchogasangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchogachos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ shākya seṅge/ shākya'i rgyal po gtso bo de rab tu byung ba'i rjes su bdag rab tu 'byung ste/ khyim pa'i rtags spong ngo*/ /rab tu byung ba'i rtags yang dag par len to/ /zhes lan gsum brjod de thabs legs bya/ rab tu byung ba'i bslab bya ni/ dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro zhing khyim pa'i rtags spong ba dang*/

rab byung gi rtags cha lugs dang ldan pa dang*/ mkhan po la gus pa sogs byed dgos so/ /rab byung gcig bu bsgrub na phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug la/ 'greng nas thal mo sbyar te/ mkhan po rin po che bka' drin che lags zhes brjod du gzhug /mkhan po 'khor bcas kyis me tog 'thor zhing*/ thar pa'i rgyal mtshan brtan par gyur cig ces sogs dang*/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*/ zhes sogs brjod par bya'o// //༈ de nas dge tshul du bsgrub pa ni/ thog mar ston pa dang de nas rang la phyag gsum re byed du 'jug cing*/ mdun du tsog pur 'dug ste thal mo snying khar sbyor du bcug nas/ khyod dge tshul du bsgrub pa la nges 'byung gi bsam pa gal che bas/ nges 'byung gi bsam pa ni 'khor ba las thar 'dod kyi blo zhig la byed pa yin pas/ de yang mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams/ dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ /mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam na/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dmyal ba na tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags la bkres skom gyi=/ dud 'gro la gcig gis gcig gsod cing za ba dang bkol spyod kyi=/ mi la tshe thung zhing na rga 'chi ba dang phongs pa'i=/ 'dod lha rnams ni tshe 'dir bag med du g.yengs shing phyi mar ngan 'gror ltung ba'i sdug bsngal yod cing*/ mdor na 'khor ba khab kyi rtse lta bu chung ba zhig la'ang sdug bden dang ma 'dres pa'i bde ba med pas/ khams gsum po gang du gnas pa dang*/ gang dang 'grogs pa dang*/ gang la longs spyod pa thams cad kyang sdug bsngal bden pa las ma 'das/ des na ngan song du ma zad/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag las thar 'dod dgos shing de las thar ba'i skyabs dam pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de'i phyir du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs ston pa/

dam pa'i chos la skyabs dngos/ dge 'dun la skyabs sgrub pa'i zla grogs zhu ba'i skyabs 'gro dang bcas pa'i sgo nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa blangs te bslab pa'i gzhi bcu po rnams legs par bsung bar bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de nas sngar gyi rab byung sgrub mkhan de min na de lugs shes dgos kyang 'dir de yin pa gzhir byas na/ mkhan po dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dge tshul du btsun pas bzung du gsol/ zhes pa lan gnyis song nas/ gsum pa'i skabs su khyed la dge tshul gyi sdom pa skye ba yin te/ de yang skyabs brjod bdag brjod gnyis rdzogs pa'i mjug gzhan brjod kyi thog mar dge tshul du zhes pa'i tshig rjogs pa dang mnyam du skye zhing*/ skyes pa na nged khyed kyi dge tshul gyi slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas/ dge tshul du zhes pa'i skabs su des skad kyi gzengs mtho ba dang*/ se gol gyi brda sprod pas de'i dus su bdag gi rgyud la dge tshul gyi sdom pa skyes pa yin no snyam pa'i thob blo skyes pa shin tu gal che/ slob dpon du gyur nas btsun pa zhes mi brjod par slob dpon zhes brjod dgos pas de yid la bzung nas gsum pa'i rjes zlos gyis zhes brjod/ gsum pa song ba dang slob dpon gyis de dge tshul du bsgrub pa'i thabs yin no dang*/ des legs so bya'o/ /des dngos gzhi'i cho ga grub/ mjug gi cho ga la dus go ba dang bslab pa brjod pa gnyis yod kyang dge tshul tsam bsgrub na skabs 'dir bya dgos shing*/ bsnyen rdzogs su bsgrub na ni de'i dus go dang bslab pa brjod pa'i nang du bsdus pas 'dir sgos su bya mi dgos so/

/bsnyen rdzogs mi byed na/ mjug gi cho ga la gnyis yod pa'i dus go ba ni mang du thos pa'i gnas brtan che ge mos mdzod ces bsgo/ de nas de nyid nyi ma yod sar phyin nas thur ma sor bzhi pas grib tshod gzhal te/ thur ma'i grib ma sor bzhi la skyes bu dang*/ sor gsum man la rkang ba'i tha snyad byas pa'i dus tshod nges par byas nas gral la 'khod/ dus go brjod tshul rgyas pa ni bsnyen rdzogs kyi skabs ltar yin la/ 'dir cung zad bsdus te brjod na/ khyed dge tshul du bsgrub pa'i mjug chog la gnyis yod pa'i dang po dus go ba ni/ khyed kyis dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa'i dus ni/ lo'i dbang du byas na lo 'di yin/ zla ba'i dbang byas nas

zla ba 'di yin/ zla ba'i yar ngo mar ngo gnyis las 'di yin/ snga dro phyi dro gnyis las 'di yin/ grib tshod skyes bu gcig dang*/ rkang pa gcig sogs song ba'i dus su khyod kyis dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob pa yin/ de yid la zhog la bsnyen bkur gyi gnas dge slong rnams dang*/ rang las rgan pa'i dge tshul rnams yin pas rnyed pa dang por 'bul zhing*/ phyag dang sngon du ldang ba sogs bya zhing rang las bslab pa gzhon pa'i dge tshul dang*/ bar ma rab byung dang*/ dge bsnyen pha ma sogs kyi phyag dang bsnyen bkur dang du long*/ de ltar byas na bstan pa'i go rim shes pa dang*/ bslab pa la gus pa'i phan yon yod do/ /mjug chog gnyis pa bslab pa brjod pa ni/ sdom pa thob pa tsam gyis mi chog gi bsrung dgos shing*/ bsrung lugs ni sngon gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa rnams kyis spang bya bcu spangs shing de las slar log par mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang de ltar bslab par bya'o snyam ste 'di'i rjes zlos kyis/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o/ /yan lag dang po 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su bslab bo/ /rjes su bsgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /gzhan yang 'phags pa de dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ brdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas dang*/ glu gar dang*/ rol mo'i sgra dang*/ phreng ba dang*/ spos nyug pa dang*/ rgyan dang kha dog 'chang ba dang*/ khri stan mthon po dang*/

khri stan chen po dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i kha zas dang*/ gser dngul len pa spangs te/ gser dngul len pa las slar log pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ brdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas dang*/ glu gar dang rol mo'i sgra dang*/ phreng ba dang spos nyug pa dang*/ rgyan dang kha dog 'chang ba dang*/ khri stan mthon po dang*/ khri stan chen po dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i kha zas dang*/ gser dngul len pa spangs te/ gser dngul len pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o/ /yan lag bcu pa 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob po/ /rjes su bsgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /thabs yin no dang legs so bya'o/ /de ltar blangs nas bsrung ba'i phan yon dang*/ ma bsrung ba'i nyes dmigs rnams shes par bya zhing*/ gal te ltung bas gos par gyur na ni bshags sdom gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /de nas phyag byas te/ slob dpon rin po che bka' drin che lags/ zhes zhu zhing*/ slob dpon 'khor bcas kyis me tog 'thor ba dang*/ gong gi smon lam bzhi gdab/ bzhi pa'i tshe dge tshul gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces bsgyur khrims kyi tshul khrims sogs kyang brjod par bya'o// //༈ de nas bsnyen rdzogs su bsgrub la/ /bsgrub bya de'i chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed gding ba sogs yo byad rnams sta gon bya/ mkhan slob tu 'os pa dang kha skong du 'os pa'i dge slong rnams dang ston pa'i sku brnyan mchod pa dang bcas pa rnams sta gon bya zhing*/ ltung bshags dang spyi bshags sogs sngar ma byas na 'dir bya/ me tog 'gyed cing rtsa pha gu bcas pa yang sta gon byas te/ mkhan slob tu 'os pa langs nas sam/ 'dug bzhin par dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/

tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par 'tshal nas/ dge 'dun la bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol na/ dge slong mang du thos pa'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa che ge mo khyod kyis gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon mdzad par zhu/ 'di ni mkhan slob gnyis gcig gis mdzad pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ gzhan rnams kyis las kyi kha skong mdzad nas tshe dang ldan pa 'di la'am/ 'di dag la bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa rnam par dag pa zhig bkas gnang bar zhu/ zhes gsol ba btab nas ston pa la me tog gtor/ de nas bsgrub bya la ston pa'i sku gzugs 'di la ston pa dngos kyi 'du shes zhog la phyag gsum gyis/ zhes brjod/ de tshar ba dang*/ khyed rang dge slong gi dge bdun gyi nang du 'jug pa'i bsam pa drag pos dge slong 'di re re la phyag gsum gsum gyis/ zhes brjod do/ /yan lag lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag bya/ phyag 'tshal ba'i tshe dge slong re re nas tshe dang ldan pa 'di'i rgyud la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa myur du thob par gyur cig ces smon lam gdab cing me tog gtor/ de nas rtsa pha gu'i steng nas mkhan po la phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug ste/ rkang ba'i rting ba gnyis kyis rtsa bting ba mnan nas tsog tsog por thal mo snying khar sbyor du bcug nas/ khyod bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi dngos po don du gnyer ba de shin tu legs/ legs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo las/ dge slong zhes bya chos kyi rgyal mtshan te/ /dge slong zhes bya rdo rje'i srog shing yin/ /dge slong zhes bya duḥkha spong ba yin/ /dge slong zhes bya rgyal ba'i sras po yin/ /dge slong zhes bya nyon mongs srog gcod de/ /dge slong zhes bya thar ba'i lam bgrod de/ /dge slong rang gi ngo bo bsdam pa ste/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i bsnyen rdzogs su sgrub pa ni/

sgrub tshul la spyir mang du 'byung yang cho ga'i dbang du byas na sngon chog dang da ltar gyi cho ga gnyis gsungs pa las/ 'dir da chog nyes med phun tshogs kyi sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa la mkhan po dgos shing*/ de yang brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i dge slong zhig la gsol ba lan gsum 'debs dgos pas/ nged kyis mkhan po'i bya ba sgrub rung du yod la/ bsnyen pa ni nye ba dang rdzogs pa ni thar pa yin pas/ bdag thar ba mya ngan las 'das pa la khad nye ba'i dge slong gi dngos po sgrub mkhan mdzad du gsol snyam pas/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan por gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ zhes brjod/ sngar dge tshul sgrub mkhan de yin pa'i dbang du btang nas/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba slob dpon la mkhan por gsol gyi/ slob dpon bdag gi mkhan po mdzad du gsol/ slob dpon mkhan pos bdag bsnyen par rdzogs par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum bya/ 'dir mkhan po yin na de dang*/ mkhan slob gang rung min na btsun pa zhes bsgyur shes dgos/ gsum pa'i mjug tu bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan por 'gyur zhing*/ mjug tu thabs legs bya'o/ /de nas phyag gsum 'tshol la nged kyi mdun du shog cig ces bsgo/ graugs byed pa chos gos gsum so sor bltab pa phrag pa g.yon pa la bkal nas/ mkhan po dang bsgrub bya gnyis 'greng ba'am ma bde na bsgrub bya 'greng ste gnyis ka'i lag pa g.yon pa 'og dang g.yas pa steng du byas te/ snam sbyar dngos sam/ de'i rgyur mi rung ba'i dod tsam yin na bzung ste 'di snam sbyar du byin gyis brlabs snyam pa gyis la/ 'di'i rjes zlos gyis shig snam sbyar yin na/ mkhan po dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i chos gos bgyis lags pa/ rung bar spyad par 'os pa 'di chos gos snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab po/ /zhes lan gsum/

dngos min pa'i dod tsam la ni/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gos 'di snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab po/ /zhes bya dgos te khyad par ro/ /thabs legs byas te phrag pa g.yas su spo/ de bzhin du bla gos dang mthang gos gnyis la de gnyis byin gyis brlab pa'i bsam pa dang rjes zlos bya zhing*/ snam sbyar gyi gnas su bla gos dang mthang gos zhes sbyor/ thabs legs kyang bya'o/ /de nas mthang gos nyis bltab byas pa bsgrub bya'i rgyan dang*/ de'i steng du bla gos dang snam sbyar sbrags nas bskon pa'i g.yon phyogs phrag pa g.yon dang*/ g.yas kyi sne mo g.yon gyi phrag pa'i steng du bzhagagayas kyi dpung ba phyir phyung ste thal mo snying khar sbyor du bcug la mgo bor me tog gtor te smon lam bzhi po brjod cing*/ bzhi pa tshe rabs thams cad du bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces bsgyur/ de nas slar gding ba'i steng nas dge 'dun la phyag lan gsum bya zhing me tog gtor/ lus tshig pa ni 'dir yang rung ngo*/ /snam sbyar gyi rgyur rung ba'i gos yug sogs yin na bltab ste bsgrub bya'i phrag pa g.yon par bkal ba'i sne mo gnyis ka lag pas sngar ltar bzung la/ mkhan po dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gos 'di snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab bo/ /'tshal la bar chad ma byung na snam phran dgu pa la sogs par bgyi ste/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa la sogs par bgyi'o/ /bkru'o/ brkyang ngo*/ /dra'o/ /bsteb bo/ / gzung gdab bo/ /drub bo/ kha bsgyur ro/ /yang na 'di la lhan thabs su lhan no/ /rkyen ji lta ba bzhin du bgyis te/ chos gos 'di ni rung bar spyad par 'os pa'o/ /lan gsum dang*/ thabs legs kyang bya'o/ /bla gos la gzhan 'dra ba la/ snam phran bdun par bgyi ste glegs bu phyed dang gsum par bgyi'o dang*/ mthang gos la snam phran lnga par bgyi ste glegs bu phyed dang gnyis par bgyi'o/

/ zhes bsgyur zhing gzhan sngar ltar ro/ /de nas mkhan pos dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun la 'di'i lhung bzed ston pa'i grogs ldan mdzod cig ces bsgo/ des lhung bzed stong pa ma yin pa rang gi lag pa g.yon par bzhag pa g.yas pas kha bkab ste/ dge slong re re'i mdun du 'greng nas 'dud pa dang bcas pas/ btsun pa'am/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i lhung bzed 'di mi chung ngam*/ mi che'am/ mi skya'am zhes 'dri zhing*/ re re nas lhung bzed bzang ngo zhes brjod cing*/ ston mkhan de la dge slong gzhan zhig gis ston lugs de bzhin du bya'o/ /mkhan po la yang bstan dgos na sngar ltar ston/ de na lhung bzed de mkhan po dang bsgrub bya gnyis ka 'greng ba'i lag pa g.yon par bzhag g.yas pas steng nas bkab ste/ 'di lhung bzed du byin gyis brlab snyam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ mkhan po dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i lhung bzed zas la spyad par 'os pa drang srong gi snod 'di bslang ba'i snod du byin gyis brlab po/ / zhes lan gsum dang*/ thabs legs bya'o/ /de nas gding ba dang chu tshags ster lugs rab byung gi skabs ji lta ba bzhin bya'o/ /bsgrub bya'i lus tshags gong du'am skabs 'dir bya ba gtso che yang gang bde/ bsgrub bya gding ba'i steng du tshur bstan nas las thos pa'i sa yin na rna ba 'gebs su 'jug cing las mi thos par byas la bzhag de nas mkhan pos/ las thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba gnyis las/ thog mar yul dus kyi stobs kyis bshags par ma nus pa'i ltung ba thun mong ba las la mi bsgrib pa'i slad du/ gsol ba'i las kyis byin gyis brlab par bgyi bas/ dge 'dun rnams spyod lam bstun nas gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las la/

bdag cag dge 'dun thams cad ni ltung ba dang bcas par gyur na gang gi mdun du bdag cag ltung ba de chos bzhin du bgyi ba/ bdag cag las dge slong gnas gzhan du mchis la dge slong gi mdun du ltung ba de chos bzhin du slar bgyid par spro ba su yang ma mchis na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyis deng ltung ba byin gyis brlabs te bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las mdzad la/ slad kyis dge slong gi mdun du ltung ba de chos bzhin du slar mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /dge 'dun thugs mthun pa'i phyir gnas la blo mthun bgyi ba ni/ las mdzad pa'i gnas 'di nye 'khor dang bcas pa tshun chad bsnyen rdzogs kyi 'phrin las kyi gnas su thugs bstun pa gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams dang*/ phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi gnas su bzhed pa/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyis gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi'o/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /gsol ba thal/ brjod pa 'jug sdud dang bcas pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi gnas su bzhed de/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyi gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams dang*/ phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi na/

tshe dang ldan pa gang dag gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams dang*/ phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsungs shig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig /dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyi gnas thams cad lags pa nang mtshams dang*/ phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las kyi blo mthun par bgyis lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsungs de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ /'dir gnas grub pa dang bgyis pa gnyis bzhag ste lags pa tsam zhig brjod pa ni gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de nas las byed pa pos/ gnas brtan ming 'di zhes bgyi ba khyed mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la gsang ste ston par spro'am/ des spro lags zhes lan gdab/ de nas/ gsang ste ston pa bsko ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la gsang ste ston par spro ba/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la gsang ste ston to/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /de nas gsang ston des bsgrub bya lkog tu 'khrid nas rang la phyag gsum 'tshal du 'jug cing*/ mdun du tsog par 'dug tu bcug ste snying khar thal mo sbyor du bcug la/ khyod bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa la mngon du gyur pa bcu tshang dgos shing*/ de'i nang nas yongs su dag pa mngon du gyur pa bar chad kyi chos dang mi ldan pa zhig dgos/ bar chad yod med ngas dris na shes pas dri ba 'di rnams la lan legs par thob cig

/tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig /'di ni khyod kyi bden pa'i dus 'di ni khyod kyi 'byung ba'i dus te/ kho bos khyod la cung zad dri yi/ khyod ma 'dzem par byos la yin pa la yin zhes smos/ ma yin pa la ma yin zhes lan legs par thob cig khyod skyes pa yin nam/ des yin lags/ skyes pa'i dbang po dang ldan nam/ ldan lags/ zhes sogs dri ba dang mthun pa'i lan gdab/ lo nyi shu lon nam/ khyod kyi chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed tshang ngam/ khyod pha ma gson pas ma gnang ba ma yin nam/ bran ma yin nam/ brkus pa ma yin nam/ rnyed btson pa ma yin nam/ rtsod pa can=/ btsong ba=/ rgyal pos bkrabs pa=/ rgyal po la bsdigs pa=/ rgyal po la gnod pa'i las byed pa=/ rgyal po la gnod pa'i las byas sam byed du bcug pa=/ chom rkun par grags pa=/ za ma ma ning =/ dge slong ma sun phyung ba=/ rku thabs su gnas pa=/ tha dad du gnas pa=/ gnas par mi bya ba=/ mu stegs can=/ mu stegs can zhugs pa=/ pha bsad pa=/ ma bsad pa=/ dgra bcom pa=/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa=/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems gyi khrag phyung ba=/ sprul pa=/ dud 'gro ma yin nam/ ma lags zhes bya/ khyod la la la'i bu lon mang yang rung nyung yang rung bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'jal mi nus pa cung zad kyang chags pa med dam/ khyod sngon rab tu byung ba ma yin nam/ khyod pham par gyur pa bzhi las ltung ba gang yang rung ba zhig byung ba ma yin nam/ ji ltar khyod da lta rab tu byung ba yin nam/ khyod kyis tshangs par spyod pa spyad dam/ lan spyad lags zhes brjod/ khyod kyi ming ci/ des bdag gi ming 'di zhes bgyi/ khyod kyi mkhan po'i ming ci/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan po'i ming 'di zhes bgyi/ zhes brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cigami rnams kyi lus la lus kyi nad rnams pa 'di lta bu dag 'byung ste/ mdze dang*/ 'bras dang*/ phol yig dang*/

'brum nad dang*/ shakra dang*/ khyi rngo dang*/ g.ya' ba dang*/ glog pa dang*/ rkang shu dang*/ skem nad dang*/ skem pa dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ bkres rngab dang*/ skya rbab dang*/ rkang bam dang*/ mtshan par rdol ba dang*/ rims dang*/ rims drag po dang*/ nyin gcig pa dang*/ nyin gnyis pa dang*/ nyin gsum pa dang*/ nyin bzhi pa dang*/ 'dus pa dang*/ rims nyin re ba dang*/ rtag pa'i rims dang*/ rims ldang dub pa dang*/ shu ba dang*/ gsung ba dang*/ skyigs bu dang*/ lud pa dang*/ dbugs mi bde ba dang*/ lhog pa dang*/ yan lag tu zug pa dang*/ skran dang*/ khrag nad dang*/ mkhris nad dang*/ gzhang 'brum dang*/ skyugs bro ba dang*/ chu 'gags pa dang*/ ngal ba dang*/ lus tsha ba dang*/ rtsibs logs tsha ba dang*/ rus pa la zug pa ste lus kyi nad 'di lta bu 'di dag las gang yang rung ba dang*/ 'di lta bu gzhan dag kyang khyod kyi lus la med dam/ des med lags zhes bya/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig khyod la da lta ngas dris pa de nyid dge 'dun gyi dbus su yang tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa'i mkhas pa rnams khyod la 'dri yis/ der yang khyod kyis ma 'dzem par byos la/ yin pa la yin zhes dang*/ ma yin pa la ma yin zhes lan thob cig de ltar na khyod bar chad kyi dag par 'dug cing ngas dge 'dun la zhus nas yong gi khyod ma bos kyi bar du ma 'ong bar 'dir sdod cig ces brjod/ dge 'dun gyi drung du 'ong ste rgan pa'i mtha' logs su 'greng nas 'dud pa dang bcas te/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag gis mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la bar chad kyi chos rnams gsang ste rjes su bstan na/ de yang bar chad kyi chos rnams yongs su dag go zhes kho na nyid mchi na/ ci mchi zhig gam/ thams cad kyis gal te yongs su dag na'o zhes brjod/ ma brjod na nyes byas so/ /de nas song ste bsgrub bya la dge 'dun gyis gnang gi shog cig ces brjod de 'khrid nas gding ba'i steng du 'dug ste dge 'dun spyi la dmigs pa'i phyag gsum 'tshal du bcug la/

rang nyid gral du 'khod par bya'o/ /de nas bsgrub bya des ston pa la phyag gsum dang*/ de nas dge 'dun spyi la phyag gsum dang*/ de nas las byed pa rang la phyag gsum byed du bcug ste/ pha gu'i steng du rtswa bting ba la rting pa gnyis kyis mnan nas tsog tsog pur thal mo snying khar sbyor la 'dug cig ces bsgo/ de nas las byed pas/ khyod bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa la/ dge 'dun la gsol ba lan gsum 'debs dgos pas 'di'i rjes zlos gyis shig dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par 'tshal te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol na/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis bdag bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis bdag drang du gsol/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis bdag rjes su gzung du gsol/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis bdag la rjes su bstan du gsol/ thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum rjes zlos byed du gzhug go /de nas nang du bar chad 'dri ba ni/ dge 'dun thugs yid ches pa'i phyir du dge 'dun gyi nang du bar chad dri ba la thugs bstun pa'i gsol ba'i las bgyid pas/ dge 'dun rnams spyod lam bstun nas gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par 'tshal te/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na/

dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang bdag gis dge 'dun gyi nang du mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ ming 'di zhes bgyi la bar chad kyi chos rnams dri bar bgyi'o/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /de nas nged la phyag gsum 'tshol la sngar bzhin pha gu'i steng du 'dug gcig ces bsgo/ 'dug pa dang khyod bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa la rgyud bar chad kyi chos dang mi ldan cing yongs su dag pa zhig dgos/ bar chad yod med sngar gsang ston gyi skabs dris zin yang*/ bar chad 'ga' zhig glo bur 'byung ba yang srid/ sngar ma dran pa dran pa'ang srid pa sogs dgos pa 'ga' zhig yod kyang*/ 'dir gtso cher dge 'dun thugs yid ches pa'i don du nang du 'dri ba yin pas lan drang por thob cig tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig 'di ni khyod kyi bden pa'i dus/ 'di ni 'byung ba'i dus te/ kho bos khyod la cung zad dri yis khyod ma 'dzem par byos la yin pa la yin pa dang*/ ma yin pa la ma yin zhes smros/ zhes pa nas/ 'di lta bu gzhan dag kyang khyod kyi lus la med dam zhes pa'i bar sngar gsang ston gyis dris pa ltar bya'o/ /de nas las byed pas/ khyod bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa la mngon gyur bcu'i sgo nas bsgrub dgos shing*/ de yang ston pa sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang slob dpon dang mkhan po dang yo byed dang yongs su dag pa dang gsol ba gdab pa dang bar chad dri ba dang las mngon du gyur pa ste bcu las/ mngon gyur gzhan thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul gyis tshang*/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skye ba la bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod pa mngon du gyur pa bsam pa'i rten rgyu'i kun slong thob 'dod dang*/ dus kyi kun slong thabs shes/ yul dang dus dang gnas skabs dang sems can dang yan lag nges pa'i 'gal rkyen nges pa lnga bral/ mkhan slob dang cho ga tshang ba dang bslab bya la slob 'dod yod pa'i mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa gsum dang ldan pa rnams dgos shing*/

sdom pa la nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa gal che bas/ bsam pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ ji skad du mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /zhes sogs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya zhes pa'i bar sngar ltar dang*/ de'i phyir du bstan pa'i gzhi la tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i gtso bo so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i cho ga bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa blangs nas ma shi'i bar du legs par bsrung snyam pa bgyis la yid gzhan du ma g.yeng bar sdod cig dge 'dun rnams spyod lam bstun nas thugs gtad cing*/ bsgrub bya cho ga mkhan slob dge 'dun la de dang der 'du shes ma 'khrul pa de dang*/ las zhe thag pa nas byed 'dod pa dang*/ bslab bya la phan par 'dod pa'i dgongs pa gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsol pa'i las la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi 'di'am/ 'di dag mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par 'tshal nas/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol te skyes pa yang lags/ skyes pa'i dbang po dang ldan/ lo nyi shu yang lon/ 'di'i chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed kyang tshang*/ bar chad kyi chos rnams kyang yongs su dag go zhes kho na nyid mchi ste/ tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyis tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ /'di ni gsol ba'o/ /gsol ba thal/ de ltar gsol ba gcig dang brjod pa gsum ste gsol bzhi'i las kyis bsgrub dgos pas/ brjod pa dang po la thugs gtad par zhu/

dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par 'tshal bas/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dge 'dun la bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol te/ skyes pa yang lags/ skyes pa'i dbang po dang yang ldan/ lo nyi shu yang lon/ 'di'i chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed kyang tshang*/ bar chad kyi chos rnams kyang yongs su dag go zhes kho na nyid mchi ste/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par gsol na/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bgyi bas bsnyen par rdzogs par bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung zhig /gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsung zhig /brjod pa dang po thal/ gnyis pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ zhes byas la gnyis pa bya/ brjod pa gsum pa'i skabs su las chogs pa yin te/ mdo rtsar brjod pa tha ma'i cha gsum pa la grub pa nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mchi ste zhes pa yan chad ngo bo brjod pa de nas bzung gsol na'i bar bya brjod pa/ de'i slad du man chad byed la brjod pa yin pas/ ngo bo brjod pa dang bya ba brjod pa gnyis rdzogs pa gsol na zhes pa'i tshig 'gags pa dang mnyam du khyod la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skye zhing nged khyod kyi slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas/ gsol na zhes pa'i skabs su nged kyis skad gzengs mtho ba zhig brjod cing*/ se gol gyi brda sbyor bas bdag gi rgyud la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skyes pa'i dus ni 'di yin snyam pa'i thob blo skyes pa shin tu gal che/ de'i slad du zhes pa'i tshig brjod pa'i tshe sdom pa skyes zin cing*/

dge slong du gyur snyam du yid ma g.yeng bar sdod cig /brjod pa gsum pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ zhes byas la gsum pa bya/ de nas dge 'dun rnams las kyi mjug sdud la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge 'dun gyis ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di mkhan po ming 'di zhes bya bas bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin te/ de ltar gsol bzhi'i las kyis khyod kyi rgyud la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa 'tshal tshul gyi rgyun sdom zhing 'gog par byed pa'i chu lon lta bu thob/ dge slong du gyur pas dga' ba bsgoms shig /des dngos gzhi grub mjug gi cho ga la dus go ba dang bslab pa brjod pa gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni/ gnas brtan che ge mos mdzod cigaces brjod/ de nas dge slong des grib tshod mjal lugs dge tshul gyi skabs ltar byas la/ 'dir mjug chog gnyis las dang po bsnyen bkur gyi gnas dang gnas ma yin pa shes par bya ba'i don du dus go ba ni/ bsnyen bkur gyi gnas ni rang las grib ma sor gcig yan chad kyi dus kyi bslab pa rgan pa'i dge slong rnams yin/ gnas ma yin pa rang las bslab pa gzhon pa'i dge slong rnams dang*/ sa gzhan na gnas pa'i dge slong rnams dang*/ dge slong ma rnams dang dge slob ma rnams dang*/ dge tshul pha ma dang dge bsnyen ma la sogs pa rnams yin/ de yang rags pa lo dang zla bas 'jog par ma zad/ tha na grib ma sor gcig yan chad kyis 'jog pa yin/ bsnyen bkur rang gi ngo bo ni phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ gral 'gor gtong ba dang*/ rnyed pa dang por 'drim pa la sogs pa yin/ rig par bya ba'i dngos po drug gam bdun tsam yod pa las/ mdo rtsa 'grel las/ phra ba'i rim pa nas bshad kyang brjod pa pos brjod bde zhing nyan pa pos bzung bde ba'i phyir lo dri mkhan po'i rjes su 'brangs nas brjod de/ dus tshigs rnams kyi phyi mo lo 'di yin pas da lo lo 'di zhes bya ba yin/

dus tshigs la dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar dang dbyar thung ngu dang dbyar ring po dang lnga las dus 'di dang zla ba 'di yin/ de'i yar ngo mar ngo gnyis las 'di yin/ tshes 'di yin/ nyin mtshan gnyis las nyin mo yin/ snga dro phyi dro gung gsum las 'di yin/ grib tshod skyes bu 'di dang rkang pa 'di'i dus su khyed kyi rgyud la dge slong gi sdom pa skyes pa yin pas/ de rnams sems la zhog la rang las rgan pa rnams la phyag dang gral la sogs pa'i bsnyen bkur stob/ rgan pas bsnyen bkur stobs pa dang du long*/ de ltar brtsis pas mnyam par gyur na phyag bya mi dgos shing*/ gral mgyogs byas pas cho ga ste/ mdo rtsa ba las/ dus mnyam pa rnams ni gcig gis gcig la phyag mi bya'o/ /sngar 'ong ba dang po yin no zhes gsungs so/ /rig par byas pa'i dgos pa dngos su sdom pa thob pa'i dus shes pa dang bstan pa'i go rim shes shing kha na ma tho bas mi gos pa dang*/ brgyud nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob par 'gyur ba yin/ de rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i dus go ba song*/ de nas gnyis pa gdam ngag brjod pa'i dgos pa ni thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i ched yin pas/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig /bzhi po 'di dag ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des/ de ltar rab tu byung ba dang*/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi gnas su spangs te/ de la gnas na legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang*/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi dngos por 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ gos phyag dar khrod pa dang*/ zas bsod snyoms pa dang*/ gnas mal shing drung dang*/ sman bkus te bor ba dang*/ 'dod pa bsod nams kyi mtha' dang*/ ngal shing dub pa'i mtha' gnyis spangs la spyod pa ste/ khyod ji srid 'tsho'i bar du gos dang zas dang gnas mal dang sman mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba la spyod par spro'am/

des spro lags zhes brjod/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cigabazhi po 'di dag ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des/ de ltar rab tu byung ba dang*/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi ltung bar 'gyur ba'i chos su gsungs te/ dge slong gis de byas na byas ma thag dge slong du mi rung*/ dge sbyong du mi rung*/ shākya'i sras su mi rung*/ dge slong gi dngos po las nyams par 'gyur te/ de'i dge sbyong gi tshul zhig par 'gyur zhing nyams pa bcom pa ltung ba pham par 'gyur te/ de'i dge slong gi tshul phyis blang du med par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ shing ta la'i mgo bo bcad na sngon por 'gyur du mi rung la/ 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang yangs par 'gyur du mi rung ba bzhin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ ma by-in par len pa dang*/ srog gcod pa dang*/ brdzun du smra ba ste/ khyod ji srid 'tsho'i bar du pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi la mi spyod dam/ des mi spyod lags/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cig /bzhi po 'di dag ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen cing gzigs pa des/ de ltar rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dge sbyong du byed pa'i chos su gsungs te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ gshe yang slar mi gshe khros kyang slar mi khro/ brdeg kyang slar mi brdegamatshang brus kyang slar mi 'bru ba ste/ khyod kyis deng phyin chad dge sbyong du byed pa'i chos bzhi la spyod dam/ des spyod lags/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cigakhyod bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob na ci ma rung snyam du smon pa gang yin pa de/ khyod mkhan por 'os pa dang slob dpon du 'os pa gnyis dang*/

dge 'dun mthun pa dang*/ gsol ba dang bzhi'i las mi g.yo ba bzhag par mi 'os pas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa khyod nyon cigabasnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa'i dge slong gis bslab pa gang la bslab par bya ba de la de ring bsnyen par rdzogs pas kyang bslab po/ de ring bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gis bslab pa gang la bslab par bya ba de la/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pas kyang bslab po/ /de ltar na tshul khrims nyid kyis mnyam pa dang*/ bslab pa nyid kyis mnyam pa dang*/ so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don pa nyid kyis mnyam pa de khyod kyis deng phyin chad bsgrub par bya yi/ mi bsgrub par mi bya'o/ /deng phyin chad khyod kyis mkhan po la pha'i 'du shes nye bar bzhag par bya'o/ /mkhan pos kyang khyod la bu'i 'du shes nye bar bzhag par bya'o/ /khyod kyis deng phyin chad mkhan po la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /mkhan pos kyang khyod shi'am gson gyi bar du nad g.yog bya'o/ /deng phyin chad khyod kyis tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa rnams dang*/ gnas brtan rnams dang*/ bar ma rnams dang*/ gsar bu rnams la gus pa dang bcas pa dang zhe sa dang bcas pa dang*/ 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'i dbang du gyur pas gnas par bya'o/ /deng phyin chad khyod kyis lung nod par bya/ bklag par bya/ kha ton bya'o/ /phung po la mkhas pa dang*/ khams la mkhas pa dang*/ skye mched la mkhas pa dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la mkhas pa dang*/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la mkhas par bya'o/ /ma thob pa thob par bya ba dang*/ ma rtogs pa rtogs par bya ba dang*/ mngon du ma byas pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir brtson pa mi 'dor bar bya'o/ /de dag ni kho bos khyod la bslab pa'i gzhi che long che long tsam zhig brjod de/ gzhan dag ni zla ba phyed phyed cing so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don pa'i tshe thos par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan dag kyang mkhan po dang*/
